description: Traçado e Georeferenciação da Rede de Distribuição Elétrica is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EDP. Traçado e Georeferenciação da Rede de Distribuição Elétrica – Alta Tensão e Subestações. Coverage: EDP. The publisher named on the listing is EDP. Its keywords include electrical-substation, electric-network, subestacoes, rede-eletrica, electric-power, electricity. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
